client.business_model: Specialty defense technology manufacturer providing mobile power systems and interactive training & simulation products for military and security customers.
client.client_history: Founded in 1990 and headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan, Arotech Corporation grew through its Training & Simulation and Power Systems divisions to become a niche defense contractor. After decades as a NASDAQ-listed public company, it was taken private by Greenbriar Equity Group in 2019 and later acquired by Albion River LLC in 2025.

revenue.source: Barchart.com income statement for fiscal-year 2018; corroborated by Wikipedia citing 10-K filings (2017 revenue $98.72M).
revenue.notes: Most recent publicly available revenue before company went private. Sources show $96.6M (2018) and $98.7M (2017); using 2018 figure and noting narrow range.

locations.source: SEC 10-K filing for year ended 2018 (sec.gov) lists facilities in Ann Arbor MI (HQ & Simulation), Hanahan SC (Power Systems), Beit Shemesh & Dimona Israel (Power Systems), and Oviedo FL (Simulation).
locations.notes: Exact current site count not stated; counting distinct facilities named in latest available 10-K.

employees.source: Wikipedia company page citing 2018 10-K (472 employees); corroborated by Mergr.com (472, 2018).
employees.notes: Annual Report 2016 listed 514; LinkedIn currently shows 74 profiles which under-represents actual workforce. Using last reported figure while private data unavailable.
